description: One registered device. Written by the mobile app when a user signs in, and deleted when they sign out or when Firebase reports the device gone.

fields.description: Cleared to stop sending to this device without deleting the record.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: What the device calls itself, so a person can tell which one to revoke.
fields.label: Device

fields.description: Updated every time the app starts. A device not seen for four months is cleared out by the weekly job.
fields.label: Last Seen

fields.description: SHA-256 of the token. This is the document name: an FCM token is longer than the 140 characters a name allows, and hashing it makes one-row-per-device something the database enforces rather than something the code has to remember.
fields.label: Token Hash

fields.description: The FCM registration token itself — the address Firebase delivers to.
fields.label: Token

name: Mobile Push Token
